source_title: GHMC Citizen Charter — Road Maintenance & Potholes
sla_note: 15 days as per GHMC Citizen Charter (Item 1: Engineering Wing)
content: As per the official GHMC Citizen Charter (Engineering Wing, Item 1), the stipulated timeframe for 'Filling of potholes / repair of road surface' on municipal roads is 15 days (360 hours).

source_title: GHMC Citizen Charter — Health & Sanitation Services
sla_note: 48 hours as per GHMC Citizen Charter (Health & Sanitation Wing: Garbage lifting & dead animal removal)
content: As per the official GHMC Citizen Charter (Health & Sanitation Wing), grievances regarding garbage not lifted from dumper bins, non-removal of dead animals, and street sanitation redressal have a stipulated timeframe of 48 hours.

source_title: GHMC Citizen Charter — Water Stagnation & Minor Drainage
sla_note: 48 hours for removal of water stagnation / minor drainage clearing (Item 2: Engineering Wing)
content: As per the official GHMC Citizen Charter (Engineering Wing, Item 2), 'Removal of water stagnation' and desilting of minor drains has a citizen charter service delivery timeframe of 48 hours.

source_title: HMWSSB Water Supply & Sewerage Citizen Charter
source_publisher: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB)
sla_note: Advisory target under HMWSSB operational guidelines; statutory resolution depends on network classification
content: Sewerage overflows, open/damaged sewerage manhole covers, and drinking water pipeline bursts are administered by HMWSSB Operations & Maintenance. Response targets are operational advisory guidelines.

source_title: TGSPDCL Consumer Charter & Electrical Safety Guidelines
source_publisher: Telangana State Southern Power Distribution Co. Ltd. (TGSPDCL)
sla_note: Advisory emergency containment target; no statutory fixed-hour contract for hazard response
content: Sagging live electrical conductors, tilted distribution poles, sparking transformers, and open junction boxes fall under the TGSPDCL Operation Circle. Safety hazard containment operates under emergency advisory protocols.

source_title: Hyderabad Traffic Police Traffic Engineering Redressal
sla_note: Operational guideline with no statutory SLA; subject to junction density and field assessment
content: Non-functioning traffic signals, timer failures, and major physical road obstructions impacting arterial junctions fall under the Hyderabad Traffic Police Engineering Wing. Response times depend on traffic priority.
